correctness.rationale: Exact two-step reduction excludes missing cycles and gives the scalar quadratic, whose sign discriminant produces the global 0/1/2/1 orbit count. The explicitly derived two-step trace/determinant reduce Schur stability to three strict inequalities. Descartes' sign bound plus exact rational sign brackets gives precisely two positive roots of the flip quartic; strict monotonicity of V and exact square comparisons isolate the two determinant-one roots. The four roots interleave, giving two and only two attracting amplitude intervals. Rational exact checks of actual map returns and Jacobians from the package passed.

value.rationale: The published 2019 map highlights period-two onset while varying c, so the complete exact orbit count and sharp local stability thresholds address a natural dynamical gap.
